import json

transcript_path = "/Users/jsriverab/.gemini/antigravity/brain/ff92a427-3657-4ec1-aecb-e7683ff23de6/.system_generated/logs/transcript_full.jsonl"

with open(transcript_path, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
    for i, line in enumerate(f):
        if "SITE_META" in line:
            print(f"Line {i} contains SITE_META!")
            try:
                data = json.loads(line)
                print(f"Step index: {data.get('step_index')}, type: {data.get('type')}, source: {data.get('source')}")
                # Save this step to a text file for inspection
                with open(f"/Users/jsriverab/.gemini/antigravity/scratch/airway-sim/scratch/step_{data.get('step_index')}.json", "w", encoding="utf-8") as out:
                    json.dump(data, out, indent=2)
                print(f"Saved to step_{data.get('step_index')}.json")
            except Exception as e:
                print("Failed to parse JSON:", e)
                # Let's save the raw line
                with open(f"/Users/jsriverab/.gemini/antigravity/scratch/airway-sim/scratch/step_raw_{i}.txt", "w", encoding="utf-8") as out:
                    out.write(line)
                print(f"Saved raw line to step_raw_{i}.txt")
